title: Over-engineered fan: integrated Arduino control
short: A basic fan turned into a remotely configurable system: variable speed, distance-based speed, forward and reverse, ±45° angle control, and automatic oscillation from one Arduino.
lede: A deliberately over-engineered fan, built to practice integrating sensing, control, and actuation in a single mechanical package.
ownership: Course project covering the CAD design, electronics integration, control logic, and assembly of the prototype.

results.label: Distinct control functions in a fully integrated, remotely configurable fan

sections.heading: Objective
bullets: Develop an Arduino-controlled fan system that integrates multiple sensing, control, and actuation modules.
Expand a basic fan into a user-configurable system with speed, direction, and angle control.

sections.heading: Design and integration
paras: The system combines an Arduino Uno, an IR remote, an ultrasonic sensor, a DC motor, a servo, and the fan assembly. The control logic coordinates multiple inputs and outputs through a single interface.
bullets: **Variable speed:** user-defined speed adjustments with smooth transitions.
**Distance-based control:** ultrasonic sensing automatically adjusts fan speed based on the user's distance.
**Rotational control:** user-selectable forward and reverse rotation.
